knowledge.name: Bundled Q2 and Q3 Deal Snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fixed synthetic opportunities include outcomes, segments, values, competitors, and loss reasons for deterministic comparison.

knowledge.name: Synthetic Buyer Feedback
knowledge.detail: Bundled feedback statements and competitive signals support loss-theme analysis without browsing or live-system retrieval.

knowledge.name: Operating Rules and Evidence Anchors
knowledge.detail: Rules define six supported operations, exact calculations, required response anchors, and fail-closed behavior.

knowledge.name: Intervention Assumptions
knowledge.detail: Fixed synthetic actions, costs, timelines, and recovery rates support clearly labeled planning scenarios.

intelligence_processing.name: Intent-to-Operation Routing
intelligence_processing.detail: An environment-selected model routes natural-language requests to one of six bounded deterministic operations.

intelligence_processing.name: Quarter and Segment Trend Analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Computes Q3 versus Q2 opportunity, win-rate, enterprise, segment, and average won-value changes.

intelligence_processing.name: Competitor Loss Breakdown
intelligence_processing.detail: Groups synthetic losses by competitor, value, reason, share of losses, and quarter-over-quarter trend.

intelligence_processing.name: Root-Cause Scoring
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks loss reasons by frequency, pipeline value, impact threshold, and fixed addressability classification.

intelligence_processing.name: Intervention Scenario Modeling
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps loss reasons to interventions and calculates synthetic recoverable value, cost, timeline, and value-to-cost ratio.

intelligence_processing.name: Strategy and Narrative Synthesis
intelligence_processing.detail: Produces draft counter-strategies, talk tracks, leadership narratives, and next-step options from bounded evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: Local Brainstem Chat
clients_user_interface.detail: The portable RAPP agent is available through the local Brainstem chat UI and /chat endpoint.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft Experience
clients_user_interface.detail: A draft Copilot Studio agent exposes six behaviors backed by two uploaded synthetic knowledge files.

clients_user_interface.name: Guided Demo and Evidence Pages
clients_user_interface.detail: Field guide, quest, tutorial, screenshots, and browser walkthroughs demonstrate the six locked scenarios.

management_reporting.name: Win/Loss Overview
management_reporting.detail: Reports quarter, segment, deal-size, and competitor patterns with a common synthetic evidence boundary.

management_reporting.name: Root-Cause Review
management_reporting.detail: Presents ranked loss drivers, buyer-feedback themes, addressability, and evidence-backed deep dives.

management_reporting.name: Counter-Strategy Review
management_reporting.detail: Drafts immediate and longer-term enablement options plus a review-only competitive talk track.

management_reporting.name: Synthetic Revenue Scenario
management_reporting.detail: Shows illustrative intervention value, win-rate paths, costs, and ratios without making forecast or revenue commitments.

management_reporting.name: Board and Action Summaries
management_reporting.detail: Creates a board narrative and candidate next steps while reserving decisions and activation for authorized leaders.

tools.name: Environment-Selected Language Model
tools.detail: Interprets user intent and presents grounded results; the deployment environment selects the available model.

tools.name: Portable WinLossAnalysisAgent
tools.detail: Single Python RAPP agent implements six read-only operations and declares no environment-variable requirements.

tools.name: Deterministic Analytics Functions
tools.detail: Python functions calculate quarter statistics, competitor breakdowns, root causes, and recovery scenarios.

tools.name: Synthetic Knowledge Package
tools.detail: Two knowledge files provide fixed source records and operating rules for portable, credential-free demonstrations.

tools.name: Copilot Studio Skills and Behaviors
tools.detail: Six operation-specific skills and behaviors mirror the portable agent's supported analysis and reporting paths.

tools.name: Brainstem RAPP Runtime
tools.detail: Loads the BasicAgent-compatible portable source as WinLossAnalysisAgent and serves local chat interactions.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-Only Fail-Closed Routing
supporting_features.detail: Only data_source synthetic, quarter Q3, and six allow-listed operations are accepted; unsupported inputs return errors.

supporting_features.name: Read-Only Execution Boundary
supporting_features.detail: The agent does not write CRM, change forecasts, approve spend, publish content, launch programs, or contact buyers.

supporting_features.name: Human Review and Approval Gates
supporting_features.detail: Sales, finance, enablement, product, security, legal, and executive reviewers retain decisions within their authority.

supporting_features.name: Scenario and Evidence Labeling
supporting_features.detail: Exact values, quotes, rates, costs, projections, and ROI remain explicitly synthetic and are not outcome claims.

supporting_features.name: Draft-Only Publication Boundary
supporting_features.detail: Validated Copilot Studio builds remain unpublished drafts; publishing requires separate explicit confirmation.

supporting_features.name: Portable RAPP Packaging
supporting_features.detail: The BasicAgent-compatible source runs locally without customer connectors or credentials and can be installed independently.
